messages:
alex_sales: Hey team — Enterprise PuddleTech is asking for SOC 2 Type II evidence and a pen-test letter as part of their security review before POC sign-off. Timeline: they want docs by EOD Friday. Any chance we can bundle a minimal package?

maria_se: tagging @rene_security and @tara_legal. POC details: 3-week POC, Dedicated, expect <100rps. They also asked about data handling & logs retention.

rene_security: We have a SOC 2 Type II attestation PDF and a standardized pen-test confirmation letter. I can generate a tailored export with customer name included. Need customer legal name + contact for the letter. No new on-site pen-test until next quarter.

tara_legal: Also need confirmation the DPA is signed. For adding a customer name to the pen-test letter we typically require a DPA or NDA. If they request vulnerability detail, we only provide a high-level summary unless there's an MoU.

alex_sales: Customer legal: "PuddleTech Inc.", contact samir.khan@puddletech.com. They signed our standard DPA via intake (ticket SR-912). Can we annotate the pen-test letter referencing that DPA?

rene_security: Good. I'll prepare a bundle: (1) SOC2_TypeII_2024.pdf, (2) PenTest_Letter-draft.docx, (3) DPA-reference note, (4) short data-handling statement. ETA: tomorrow noon.

tara_legal: I'll review the pen-test wording for liability language. We cannot include raw vuln details. Approved to add customer name given DPA exists; will redact sensitive internal notes.

customer_cto: Quick Q (Samir): can you add a short statement saying PII is not retained in logs for the POC? My compliance folks need that explicit line.

maria_se: Short answer: we don't persist PII in production traces by default. For the POC we can enable request hashing + TTL 7 days. I'll add exact copy to the package: "We do not persist customer PII in logs; request-level traces are hashed and retained for 7 days for debugging only."

alex_sales: Perfect. @rene_security @tara_legal please cc samir on the final package. I can deliver to them if you want to scrub internal comments.

rene_security: Uploaded draft bundle -> https://internal.redwood.com/compliance/sales/1768923456-puddletech-bundle.zip :pkg: Contains SOC2 PDF, pen-test letter draft, DPA reference, data-handling note. View-only for Sales.

tara_legal: Reviewed and left comments in the pen-test doc. I approve adding the customer name and the DPA reference. Re: vulnerability details — added standard redaction paragraph.

alex_sales: Shared with samir.khan@puddletech.com. He replied: "Thanks — looks good. Could you add an explicit line that model weights are third-party open models and not customer data?" Also asked for pricing for a 3-week dedicated POC with 4 GPUs.

maria_se: For pricing: we do base Dedicated monthly minimum + prorated POC add-on. Quick calc coming via DM. High-level: 4 x GPU-rate prorated + short-term infra premium.

rene_security: FYI: pen-test letter will include: "No known uncompensated critical findings as of date of issue." We can't guarantee future state.

customer_cto: Also asking if they can run their own vendor test limited to the POC scope. They want to validate the environment only.

tara_legal: We allow customer-run tests with a scoping agreement, test window, and named contacts. We'll need a signed testing addendum.

alex_sales: Ok I'll coordinate scoping and schedule post-POC-date finalization. Thanks all :thumbsup:

jira_bot: SR-912 updated: attachments added (SOC2 attestation, pen-test letter draft).
